mapper.select: SELECT product_id, date FROM inventory_valuation_cals WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY created

SELECT inv.pid AS product_id, MIN(inv.date) AS date FROM inventory_valuations inv INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gld.inventory_valuation_id = inv.id WHERE inv.is_active = 1 AND inv.is_var_cost = 1 AND IFNULL(gld.debit, 0) = 0 AND IFNULL(gld.credit, 0) = 0 GROUP BY inv.pid ORDER BY MIN(inv.date)

SELECT pid, on_hand, on_hand_small, avg_cost, asset_value, sales_order_id FROM inventory_valuations WHERE is_active = 1 AND date < #{calDate} AND pid = #{productId} ORDER BY date DESC, created DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT inv.id, inv.is_var_cost, inv.is_adjust_value, inv.pid, inv.sales_order_id, inv.small_qty, inv.qty, inv.date, inv.cost, inv.price, inv.on_hand, inv.on_hand_small, inv.avg_cost, inv.asset_value, p.small_val_uom FROM inventory_valuations inv INNER JOIN products p ON p.id = inv.pid WHERE inv.is_active = 1 AND inv.date >= #{calDate} AND inv.pid = #{productId} ORDER BY inv.date, inv.created, inv.id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_valuations SET on_hand = #{onHand}, on_hand_small = #{onHandSmall}, cost = #{cost}, avg_cost = #{avgCost}, asset_value = #{assetValue} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE general_ledger_details SET debit = 0, credit = 0 WHERE inventory_valuation_id = #{inventoryValuationId} AND inventory_valuation_is_debit = 1 AND debit != 0
